name: MD-3
description: MD-3 was an MD-3 medical droid assigned to the Imperial Navy EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate. Its service carried over once the ship's crew mutined and took over control of the vessel. MD-3 was responsible for operating the medical bay's bacta tanks, and operated the pharmacy. The droid also assisted MD-1 on occasion with duties in the medical lab.
